name: io.github.arturogarrido/claudinho
description: Live football scores, fixtures and standings for 15 supported competitions. Unofficial fan project.

environmentVariables.description: Locale for dates, attribution, and commentary: en, es, pt, or fr (optional; default en)
environmentVariables.name: CLAUDINHO_LANG

environmentVariables.description: IANA timezone for kickoff times, e.g. America/Mexico_City (optional; default system)
environmentVariables.name: CLAUDINHO_TZ

environmentVariables.description: Commentary flair: off, subtle, or full (optional; default full)
environmentVariables.name: CLAUDINHO_FLAVOR

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'off' to hide read-only prediction-market signals (optional; informational only)
environmentVariables.name: CLAUDINHO_MARKETS

environmentVariables.description: The competition the server answers for, by alias or ESPN slug, e.g. premier-league or eng.1 (optional; a tool call's competition argument wins, else the choice saved with claudinho follow)
environmentVariables.name: CLAUDINHO_COMPETITION

environmentVariables.description: The team get_next_fixture answers for when a call names none, by name or code, e.g. Arsenal or ARS (optional; else the team pinned with claudinho follow --team)
environmentVariables.name: CLAUDINHO_TEAM
